articles.title: NVIDIA Sets Conference Call for Third-Quarter Financial Results
articles.summary: NVIDIA will host a conference call on Tuesday, November 17, at 2 p.m. PT (5 p.m. ET) to discuss its financial results for the third quarter of fiscal year 2027, which ended October 25, 2026.

articles.title: NVIDIA and Oracle Expand NVIDIA Vera Rubin to Multi-Gigawatt Scale and Bring NVIDIA Vera CPU to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure
articles.summary: NVIDIA and Oracle today announced plans to expand Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Superclusters with NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 systems to multi-gigawatt scale, supporting growing customer demand for AI training, inference and agentic applications.

articles.title: NVIDIA and Meta to Expand Collaboration on Muse and Muse Family of Models Amid Robust Growth
articles.summary: NVIDIA and Meta today announced they will partner to expand their work on Muse and the Muse family of models to improve inference and training performance, reflecting popular demand for useful AI agents.

articles.title: NVIDIA and Supply Chain Partners Expand Capacity to Accelerate AI Infrastructure Buildout
articles.summary: NVIDIA today announced plans with a group of supply chain partners to expand global manufacturing capacity to meet growing demand for its accelerated computing and full-stack AI factory platform.
